_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd stationeers/stationeers_vanilla/egg-stationeers.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the stationeers tag, an automatic update/query port (the port after the game port) instead of the fixed 27015, the Steam query (A2S) on it for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, makes the server password and the admin secret (ServerAuthSecret) optional, editable and passed only when set, one word each (upstream passed the hidden defaults "change" and "changechange" to every server), refuses double quotes, slashes and backslashes in the station name (it is a quoted argument and the save folder), limits the start location to a plain id, fixes the start condition rule (a stray space), keeps UPnP off (Octail publishes the ports), drops the stray ";2>&1" at the end of the startup, waits for "RakNet successfully hosted with Address:" as the done line (current builds no longer print upstream's "Host override address provided:"), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#
 ##

# Install packages. Default packages below are not required if using our existing install image thus speeding up the install process.
#apt -y update
#apt -y --no-install-recommends install curl lib32gcc-s1 ca-certificates

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/rocketstation_DedicatedServer.x86_64" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Stationeers dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/rocketstation_DedicatedServer.x86_64

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Auto Pause Server
variables.description: Weather the server should auto pause or not if no players are connected

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Available Maps: Lunar, Mars2, Europa3, MimasHerschel, Vulcan, Venus

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Time in seconds between each autosave. Shouldn't be below 60 sec.

variables.name: Admin Secret
variables.description: Optional: the ServerAuthSecret. Players who set the same secret in their game (settings ServerAuthSecret <secret> in the F3 console) can run server commands with serverrun. Empty = none. One word: no spaces or quotes.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password. One word: no spaces or quotes.

variables.name: Start Location
variables.description: Highly depend on Map! Search trough https://stationeers-wiki.com/Dedicated_Server_Guide World types to get exact Location IDs

variables.name: Station Name
variables.description: The name of the world save and of the server in the list (up to 100 characters, no double quotes, slashes or backslashes). The save with this name is loaded at every start, or created.

variables.name: UPNP
variables.description: UPnP port forwarding. Off: Octail publishes the ports.

variables.name: Update Port
variables.description: Steam update and query port (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: UseSteamP2P
variables.description: Weather the server should allow SteamP2P connections. Keep this disabled.
